page.overview:
Who is Luke Robinson?

Always a great dreamer, years ago Luke discovered the allure of the Dreamlands. He had climbed down the Seventy Steps of Light Slumber, faced the judgment of Nasht and Kaman-Thah, and walked through the Doors of Sleep; from then on he spent every night delving into its secrets. He wandered the sleeping world exploring all that he could, and discussed the reality of the place with its denizens before stumbling across the greatest truth of all: the Dreamlands were a real place, and one could travel there, if one knew how.

Gathering up his meagre possessions and setting his affairs in order, Luke made his way to the portal he had been told of and passed through, thinking that he would never again see the waking world.

However, word came to Luke that something catastrophic was happening in Arkham, that an evil from before time was rearing its ugly head once again. So, collecting his things for a second time, Luke prepared to leave the Dreamlands, to return to the waking world and prepare to defend his old home.

In Graham McNeill's 2012 novel, while living in the city of Oriab, Luke encountered Henry Cartwright, an amnesic dreamer whose body was dying in the waking world. He travelled back and located Cartwright's companions, who made their way to the Dreamlands - with help from the Terrible Old Man - and saved the poor man.(: Bones of the Yopasi)
